old_caption:
The video captures a serene winter scene set in a snowy forest. A large bonfire burns brightly at the center of the frame, casting a warm glow against the cold, white backdrop. The fire is composed of various pieces of wood, some charred and others still burning fiercely. Smoke rises steadily from the flames, adding to the cozy ambiance. In the background, snow-covered trees stand tall, their branches heavy with fresh snowfall.

One individual, wearing a light-colored jacket and an orange hat, walks toward the left side of the frame, moving away from the fire. This person appears to be carrying something in their hands, though it's unclear what it is due to the distance and angle. The individual throws a long piece of wood into the fire, causing a burst of flames and smoke. The fire's intensity visibly increases after the wood is thrown. The individual exits the frame to the left. Throughout the video, the camera remains stationary.

caption:
The video captures a large bonfire of stacked lumber burning in a snow-covered clearing ringed by dense, snow-dusted pine trees. A rounded rock rests at the fire's left base, a cut stump sits to the right, and a thin yellow pole leans in the background. Bright orange-yellow flames and a pale gray-white smoke column rise from the wood pile. The flat boards piled at the left keep the same positions frame to frame.

A person in a gray hooded top, dark trousers and orange hat stands left of the fire, then shifts leftward and exits the frame. Only the fire burns for a moment. Near the middle a gloved hand and a long, light-colored wooden plank appear at the left edge, angled toward the fire base, before both vanish. The flame height and shape flicker throughout, taller plumes giving way to lower ones, while the smoke column shifts and thickens. The wood pile, rock, stump, yellow pole and tree line hold fixed positions.

The bonfire still burns brightly here.
